components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Horizontal app navigation with a coral underline for the current section.
components.html: PulsePilot
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:60px; min-height:84px; padding:0 max(32px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2)); background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font:600 13px/1.7 var(--font-manrope,Arial),sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { font-size:24px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.035em; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-nav nav { display:flex; align-self:stretch; gap:28px; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; border:0; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; padding:3px 0 0; background:transparent; color:#b5c3d3; font:inherit; text-align:left; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:#fff; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-bottom-color:#f69278; color:#fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ce6a49; outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:800px) { .ds-nav { flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; padding:20px 24px 0; } .ds-nav nav { width:100%; gap:26px; } .ds-nav-item { min-height:50px; font-size:12px; } } @media(max-width:520px) { .ds-nav { padding:18px 20px 0; } .ds-nav nav { justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; } .ds-nav-item { gap:6px; font-size:11px; } }

narrative.overview:
PulsePilot reads as a calm measurement workspace. Deep navy anchors navigation and the camera area; the warm canvas and white surfaces keep measurements legible. Coral marks primary actions, active navigation, and face-alignment brackets. Fine rules organize supporting evidence without adding visual weight.

At wide widths, the camera and its controls lead on the left while heart rate, coaching, and setup evidence sit on the right. The layout stacks as space narrows. Manrope, balanced headings, compact labels, and tabular numerals keep the experience familiar and readable. Measurement and chart states remain explicit, including empty and preliminary data.
keyCharacteristics: Warm canvas with white, lightly bordered measurement surfaces.
Coral action cues and face-alignment brackets.
Teal and amber chart colors retain their data meanings.

rules.name: The Semantic Series Rule
rules.body: Accepted heart-rate estimates stay teal; preliminary estimates stay amber and dashed. The normalized waveform keeps its separate teal trace. The face heatmap's red-to-yellow scale represents model attention, not blood flow.

rules.name: The Tabular Reading Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for heart-rate values, durations, and report statistics so changing measurements stay aligned.

rules.name: The Responsive Stack Rule
rules.body: Preserve the camera-first, evidence-second order when the two-column workspace collapses to one column at 800px.

dos: Do keep the primary action coral and the app canvas warm and neutral.
Do use white, lightly bordered surfaces for measurements and report evidence.
Do keep accepted and preliminary heart-rate series distinguishable by both color and line treatment.
Do leave unavailable readings empty and preserve the visible measurement state.
donts: Don't style a preliminary estimate as an accepted measurement.
Don't present the FacePhys heatmap as a blood-flow or heart-rate visualization; it shows model attention.
Don't fill empty charts or readings with invented values.
